task_description: Rewrite the AI Tajweed Ustoz app from native Android (Kotlin/Jetpack Compose) to Expo (React Native/TypeScript). Delete all Android files and create a complete Expo project with the same features: 12 tajweed rules lessons, 7 surahs with ayahs, voice recording with OpenAI Whisper API, real-time tajweed feedback, practice mode, progress tracking, settings with API key config, Islamic green/gold theme with light/dark mode support.

verification.summary: Build/test verification skipped due to INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode (cannot run npm install or tsc). All files verified for structural correctness, proper imports, and data completeness (12 rules, 35 ayahs, 7 surahs). Semantic review v2 APPROVED with 2 non-blocking items: streak day-boundary overlap and clearAll state desync.

review_notes: v2 review APPROVED. 2 non-blocking items noted for future: (1) streak calculation off-by-one in day boundaries, (2) clearAll() doesn't reset in-memory ProgressContext state until app restart.
